blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors are entering a crucial five-game stretch of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament, with their Final Four hopes hanging on their ability to keep their position in an increasingly tight race. While the Benedicto College Cheetahs appear headed toward a Final Four berth with their league-best 9-1 record, the battle for the remaining three spots remains wide open. The University of the Visayas (UV) sits at second with a 7-3 record, followed by USC at third with a 7-4 slate. MORE CESAFI ACTION: USJ-R Jaguars pounce […]...
